A1.justification: Both PDFs contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures and appendices describing the same Fast Direct work. Content can be reliably matched across figure relocation and appendix renumbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original image-generation experiments, molecular binding-affinity simulations, generalization evaluations and ablations in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v5 retains these original empirical results, including the molecule-results plot relocated to Appendix H.

M1.justification: Algorithms 1 and 2 retain the same noise updates, normalization, sampling and pseudo-target procedures. Both the GP-gradient and historical-optimum pseudo-target choices are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same 12 image-alignment prompts, six molecular receptor tasks, and compressibility, incompressibility and aesthetic-quality tasks using the same 45 training prompts and 16 unseen animal prompts.

E2.justification: Image-optimization comparisons retain DDPO, DPOK, D3PO and DNO; molecule and unseen-prompt comparisons retain DDPO, DPOK and D3PO. CASBO is added only to the related-work overview, without experimental comparison.

E3.justification: The stated models, sampling steps, query budgets, batch sizes, objective metrics and Gemini settings remain unchanged. Appendix A retains the same prompt-sampling and frozen-model generalization procedures; no new evaluation protocol is introduced.

E4.justification: The noisy-target demonstrations, step-size and batch-size ablations, runtime analysis, intermediate-direction comparisons and generated-image examples are retained. Appendices B and C contain the same analyses under renumbered figures.

E5.justification: Both versions report DNO averages from 16 independent image-alignment trials and 45 prompt-specific trials in Appendix A. Run-count disclosures and statistical reporting practices are unchanged; no uncertainty intervals or significance tests are added.

E6.justification: Table 1 values, result plots and generated-image panels are unchanged. All 50 embedded images match between versions. The molecule plot moves from v1 Figure 5 to v5 Figure 10 without changing its results.

T1.justification: Proposition 1, its GP-gradient subspace statement, and the proof in Appendix E remain unchanged. The method equations and mathematical assumptions are also retained.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: robust GNSO, query-efficient Fast Direct, approximately 6–10-fold image and 11–44-fold molecule query-efficiency gains, and generalization to unseen prompts.

C2.justification: The manifold-based mechanism explanation, noisy-target interpretation, sampler discussion and generalization qualifications retain their meaning. The conclusion still identifies understanding the underlying theoretical principles as future work.

D1.justification: Hyperparameters, baseline implementation instructions, Gemini query templates, runtime information and implementation URLs are retained. Making previously printed resource URLs clickable does not introduce new reproducibility information.

R1.justification: v5 adds Lyu et al. (2024), Covariance-adaptive sequential black-box optimization for diffusion targeted generation, to the bibliography and lists CASBO as online black-box inference-time guidance in Appendix F, Table 2. The broader positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v5 makes local grammar and phrasing corrections throughout, updates affiliations and contact details, and adds acknowledgments. A new Appendix H houses existing molecule results, shifting subsequent appendix letters while preserving the main narrative structure.

P2.justification: The molecule plot is relocated and enlarged, Figure 2 moves within its page, and appendix displays reflow. Table 2 adds CASBO and repairs the malformed final-row alignment visible in v1. The underlying figure content is retained.

improvement.justification: v5 improves readability through grammatical corrections, repairs Table 2's misaligned Fast Direct entry, and modestly improves related-work coverage by acknowledging CASBO. These are useful, limited gains; the methods, theory and empirical evidence remain unchanged.
